text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon finishes first!
Mihono Bourbon takes the victory!
(UWAAAAAHH--!)

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"I was wrong...!
What an incredible Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe, just maybe...
she might actually achieve the Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: I want to see... where Mihono Bourbon's path leads next...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Classic Triple Crown...
This is the Satsuki Sho...!
choice_data_list: That was a great run, Bourbon!
That was a great run, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Order completed...!

"Thunderous applause enveloped Mihono Bourbon.
The excitement of the crowd showed no signs of abating for some time."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I presume the Japan Derby is next.
Will that be acceptable?
choice_data_list: Of course! Let's do our best and win!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order received. Victory is guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Winning the Japan Derby is essential to achieving
the Classic Triple Crown. I have some requests to that end.
It's rare for Mihono Bourbon to express a personal wish. If possible, I'd like to grant it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"According to market research, it is said that the 'Japanese Derby'
is a race won by the luckiest Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I request the acquisition of a lucky charm
and training to improve our fortune.

As Mihono Bourbon spoke with a straight face,
I agonized over how best to respond.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't... reach it at all...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"But of course they would... Because
Rice... has always been so 'amazing'...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice has to change properly...!

That night. After returning home from Nakayama Racecourse, she said
she wanted to run a bit, so when we went to the track—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*...!
*pant*... *sniff*...!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice-san is training.
In addition, 'tears' have been detected. What on earth—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!
(*splat*)
Rice Shower tumbled to the ground. Without thinking, I stop Mihono Bourbon as she tries to rush over.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, Master...
choice_data_list: Let's watch over them a bit longer.

text_block_list.text:
After a short while, Rice Shower
stood up, and—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*... *sob*
And so, she started running once more.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice... Rice is going to...
become much stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"One day, without fail... I'll catch up...
to Bourbon-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Master. I am not adept at interpreting emotions.
What was the meaning behind that?
Come to think of it, she had said something similar before.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice wishes she could become
like that in the Twinkle Series too...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can say goodbye
to the Rice Shower that brings misfortune to everyone...
It didn't look like Rice Shower was competing against Mihono Bourbon—it seemed more like she admired her, chasing after her.

Perhaps burdened by that longing,
she just couldn't be satisfied with her own running.
choice_data_list: I'm sure she's just feeling frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Frustrating"...

Mihono Bourbon murmured, seemingly
still not quite grasping what was meant.

I'm concerned about Rice Shower, too...
Even so, I can't just spend all my time worrying.

Next is finally the Japan Derby.
I psyched myself up once more.
